items.summary: Ukraine's state gas company Naftogaz said on Telegram that Russia attacked its gas production infrastructure in the northeastern Kharkiv region on Wednesday: a drone struck one of the units at the production site. The wire gave no casualty figure. A second independent outlet has not yet carried this specific strike; the Al Jazeera mirror hit found in search was a stale May-2026 republication and was excluded.
items.title: Russian drone hits Naftogaz gas production site in Kharkiv region

items.event_time_ist: Wednesday Oct 21, 2026 (Kremlin briefing; reported ~4:29 PM IST / 11:29 UTC)
items.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov, at Wednesday's briefing (TASS), said Putin is not considering an energy ceasefire with Ukraine and Moscow's position is unchanged: 'Russia needs peace, not a truce.' He added that a full resolution of the war requires the participation of Ukrainian officials ('Someone there has to make a responsible decision'). Asked about the new peace proposals Finland's President Stubb said were developed at the Norway meeting and would be presented to Russia, Peskov said restating a pan-European position is 'unlikely to make a constructive contribution' to a settlement. (Kyiv Post: 'Kremlin Rejects Energy Ceasefire But Says Full Peace Deal Requires Ukraine's Participation'; The Istanbul Post carried Peskov's Wednesday remarks too.)
items.title: Kremlin rejects energy truce: 'Russia needs peace, not a truce'
